description: This script handles command-line argument parsing and execution of a benchmarking process for CLI startup performance. It supports help display, argument parsing, and invoking a child process to run the benchmark with specified options.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments based on provided flags.

methods.description: Defines a flag for string-type command line arguments.

methods.description: Defines a flag for integer-type command line arguments.
